title: Add proportional replay orchestrator and blended-quality CI gate
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduce a proportional replay orchestrator that replays failing prompt cohorts across recent baselines and a blended-quality CI gate that fuses multiple signals (accuracy, calibration drift, latency regression) with adaptive thresholds. Improves signal-to-noise for prompt-set regressions and reduces noisy CI failures.
description:
Context and motivation: Our prompt-set regression CI has been producing frequent noisy failures tied to small, cohort-specific regressions and run-to-run variance. Root causes include unbalanced replay (over-sampling small cohorts), single-metric gating that amplifies false positives, and lack of cross-seed replay. This PR implements two orthogonal features to address these problems: (1) a proportional replay orchestrator that constructs replay batches by weighting prompt cohorts proportionally to failure severity and sample variance across recent baselines; (2) a blended-quality CI gate that computes a composite score from multiple evaluators (task accuracy, per-prompt calibration, latency percentiles) and applies an adaptive threshold calibrated using historical variance. Both pieces are integrated into the CI pipeline with feature-flagged rollout and telemetry.

Summary of changes: commits below implement the orchestrator, the gate logic, metric exporters, tests, docs, and CI wiring. Key behaviors: proportional replay avoids overemphasizing tiny cohorts; cross-seed replay reduces seed-specific flakiness; blended-quality gate reduces single-metric sensitivity and supports configurable weights; adaptive thresholds use exponential smoothing over a 14-day baseline to stabilize gating decisions. Backwards-compatible defaults are provided so existing CI setups do not change until the feature flag is enabled.

Commits (high-level):
- feat(replay): add proportional_replay.Orchestrator, sampling strategy and unit tests
- feat(ci): add blended_quality_gate adapter and CI hook integration
- feat(metrics): add blend_score exporter and histogram tagging for cohort/seed
- test: add e2e smoke and deterministic replay tests with synthetic cohorts
- docs: add README and runbook describing tuning knobs and rollback steps
- ci: wire new gate into smoke and nightly pipelines behind feature flag

Changed files (high-level):
- orchestrators/proportional_replay.py
- orchestrators/__init__.py
- ci/hooks/blended_quality_gate.py
- metrics/exporters/blend_score_exporter.py
- tests/unit/test_proportional_replay.py
- tests/e2e/test_replay_orchestrator.py
- docs/eval/README-proportional-replay.md
- scripts/ci/update-gates.yml
- examples/prompt-sets/regen-weighted-sample.yaml

Testing and CI: Local unit tests added for sampling invariants and edge cases (zero-count cohorts, extreme variance). E2E tests run a deterministic replay against a synthetic model stub to assert stability improvements. On CI this ran in two iterations: initial run failed due to a flaky test in tests/e2e/test_replay_orchestrator.py; flaky test was stabilized by switching to a seeded RNG and adding a short wait for background metrics flush. Final CI status: all checks passed. Full CI matrix: lint (pass), unit (pass), e2e (pass after rerun), metrics smoke (pass), integration (pass).

Review thread (highlights):
- Ethan Ross: "Can the orchestrator be configured to prefer recency over severity for some customers?" — response: "Yes — we added 'recency_weight' in the config and documented tradeoffs in the README; default remains severity-first." (resolved)
- Priya Kapoor: "Blended score uses simple weighted average today; can we add a robust aggregator (trimmed mean) to reduce outlier influence?" — response: "Added an optional 'robust_mode' flag that applies trimmed mean; default is legacy weighted avg for reproducibility." (resolved)
- Lena Park: "Concern: cost impact of cross-seed replay on nightly runs." — response: "We added proportional caps and an adaptive budgeter that limits total replay tokens per run; documented cost implications and added a metric to track replay token consumption." (resolved)
- QA note (Raghu): "I hit a timing issue with metrics flush on slow CI agents." — action: "Added flush-wait and telemetry backoff; CI rerun green." (resolved)

Rollout and rollback plan: The feature is behind 'eval/proportional_replay' feature flag. Default is off for all orgs. Enable initially for internal/QA orgs, run 3 nights, monitor blend_score trends and noisy_failure_rate. Rollback by disabling the flag (CI gate reverts to previous simple-metric gate) or by reverting the merge if critical.

Telemetry and observability: New metrics: replay.batch_size, replay.token_consumed, blend_score.value (per-cohort), blend_gate.decision (pass/fail), blend_gate.threshold. Dashboards and an alert are included in the docs runbook; the alert triggers on sustained increase of noisy_failure_rate > 2x historical baseline for 24h.

Notes and related links: Linked Linear: ENG-8421. See docs/eval/README-proportional-replay.md for configuration guide and tuning advice. This PR is intended to reduce noisy regressions and improve developer signal confidence in CI gating.

testing_instructions: Enable feature flag in a staging org, run nightly pipeline for 3 nights, verify blend_score distribution and noisy_failure_rate in dashboards, run e2e deterministic replay test locally: pytest tests/e2e/test_replay_orchestrator.py -k deterministic --seed 42.
